text_block_list.text:
"October, one year before the BC...
Espoir City had steadily grown in strength,
but had recently hit a plateau."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Dammit!
Why can't my legs hold out?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't blow everyone away at the BC, it's all for nothin'!
Too heavy? Quit messin' around and move, dammit...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City-san,
do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, there's been a plumbing issue,
and the entire floor your room is on will be out of commission just for tonight...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? We can't even go back to our room?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... We are guiding students who can't return to their rooms
to vacant rooms in Ritto, but we're running out of rooms...
So, we have a request—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I heard from Tazuna. There are still vacant rooms over in Miho, so feel free to use them as you like.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Hey, Espo.
Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Not really. I'm totally fine...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That was a pretty half-hearted reply.
Are you hungry or something?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then that's perfect, I was just making a late-night snack!
You grab a bite too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Told you, I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Food is the source of all energy!
Here, eat up, even if it's just a single bite!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh! Wh-what is this...?
It's insanely good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Eat well and build up your strength.
That way, you can keep being stubborn all you want, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What're you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You looked completely dispirited earlier.
When you're a dorm leader,
you end up seeing that face a whole lot."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
――Right now you're feeling rushed and spinning your wheels.
Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hit the nail on the head, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, times like that are when you gotta keep your head high and bluff your way through with a poker face.
The one who wins in the end is the one with the stubborn pride to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So make sure you eat well and get some sleep.
—So you can keep holding your head high tomorrow, too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! Mind your own business!
Besides, I ain't panicking at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Putting up a tough front like that is just like you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! I'm not trying to act tough,
I'm seriously totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......Dammit.
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Why won't you listen to me, legs...!
There's only one year left till the BC, dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Dammit! One more lap!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(My legs are heavy, damn it...! And I'm out of breath...!
At this rate—I'm gonna choke again...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, times like that are when you gotta keep your head high and bluff your way through with a poker face.
The one who wins in the end is the one with the stubborn pride to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, why am I remembering Hishi Ama's words now...?!
Ah, dammit! But still—...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(――...Honestly, it's lame as hell...!
If I can't stick to my guns to the very end...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—Ah, that's right...! I'm the "Strongest Umamusume"!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Legs feel heavy? Lungs burning?
Like I give a crap! I'm gonna—!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine, dammit allllll!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Espo.
Did you leave something behind at Miho?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
As if. It's just... it gave me a bit of inspiration.
Like, how to stick to your guns, ya know—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So I'm just here to settle things square.
They call this repaying a favor for room and board, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well aren't you dutiful!
Come on back to Miho whenever you feel like it!
I'll treat ya to a delicious meal!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—...Yeah.
...Thanks.
